description: Tournament Path Score values bracket-path evidence without letting final finish dominate CPI.
principles: Final placement is a supporting signal, not the ranking outcome.
Opponent quality and path difficulty matter more than raw finish.
Advancing into a stronger path can still be positive even if a team loses later placement games.
Tournament type and recency affect weight.

finish_score.description: Small supporting signal using overall finish estimate when available. If unavailable, use path advancement proxy.
